text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What on earth... was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is this... heat? It's as if it's 
overflowing from deep within my body. I 
can't quite explain it...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However—Nicht schlecht. It doesn't feel 
bad at all.
